claim_scope: secondary post-hoc exploratory gates; no formal risk guarantee

data_flow.output: Always-neural and always-fuse window probabilities for each of five seeds, then per-class window-level seed median.
data_flow.target_information: Final base models generate neural, RF and Extra Trees probabilities for the untouched target recordings.
data_flow.training_information: Base-model OOF probabilities from recording-disjoint inner folds; stacker uses only OOF logits with inverse-recording-window sample weights.

data_flow.output: One cell-level hard choice between the frozen five-seed-median always-neural and always-fuse probabilities.
data_flow.target_information: Covariance shift uses all windows from the same participant's three unlabeled target recordings r1-r3.
data_flow.training_information: For each source participant, two recording-disjoint folds over four source recordings; OOF gain is calculated on source levels r1-r3.

data_flow.output: One cell-level hard choice between the frozen five-seed-median branches.
data_flow.target_information: Covariance shift uses all four unlabeled recordings of the held-out participant.
data_flow.training_information: Within each outer training population, inner participant-level OOF predictions estimate fused-minus-neural validation gain.

data_flow.output: p_CB-SF=(1-lambda)p_NN+lambda p_fuse for every target window, with one shared lambda per participant-direction cell.
data_flow.target_information: All windows from the three unlabeled target recordings jointly determine one diagnostic vector and one weight.
data_flow.training_information: Leave-one-participant-out gate training over the other 12 participants and both directions (24 participant-direction rows). Benefit labels come from source-task OOF accuracy only.

data_flow.output: One transductive batch weight shared by the four recordings.
data_flow.target_information: All windows from all four unlabeled target recordings jointly determine one diagnostic vector and one weight.
data_flow.training_information: For each held-out participant, 14 inner participant OOF rows train the gate; the outer target participant is absent.

data_flow.output: One transductive batch weight shared by the four recordings.
data_flow.target_information: All windows from all four unlabeled target recordings jointly determine one diagnostic vector and one weight.
data_flow.training_information: For each held-out participant, 12 inner participant OOF rows train the gate; the outer target participant is absent.

formulas.dasf_choice: always-fuse iff OOF gain > margin; otherwise always-neural

gate_features.aggregation_unit: All windows in the source reference batch and all windows in the unlabeled target batch.
gate_features.zero_variance_and_outlier_handling: If std_S<1e-6: z_j=0 when mean difference<=1e-6, otherwise 10; non-finite values become 10; all z_j are clipped to [0,10].

gate_features.aggregation_unit: Mean over every window in the target participant-direction batch.
gate_features.zero_variance_and_outlier_handling: Frozen probabilities must be finite and row-normalized.

gate_features.aggregation_unit: Mean binary Shannon entropy over all target-batch windows; natural logarithm.
gate_features.zero_variance_and_outlier_handling: Each probability is clipped from below at 1e-12 before log.
